# Lab 2.6: Logical & Materialized Views

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a logical view and a materialized view, then check automatic refresh and automatic query rewrite.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Copy source data into your dataset.** Materialized views need base tables you own.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE TABLE lab02.trips AS
SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips`;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Create a logical view.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE VIEW lab02.v_long_trips
OPTIONS (description = 'Trips over 60 minutes') AS
SELECT trip_id, start_station_name, duration_minutes
FROM lab02.trips
WHERE duration_minutes &gt; 60;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab02.v_long_trips;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Create a materialized view.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW lab02.mv_trips_by_station
OPTIONS (enable_refresh = TRUE, refresh_interval_minutes = 60) AS
SELECT start_station_name, COUNT(*) AS trips, SUM(duration_minutes) AS total_minutes
FROM lab02.trips
GROUP BY start_station_name;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] See automatic query rewrite.** Query the base table, not the view:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT start_station_name, COUNT(*) AS trips
FROM lab02.trips
GROUP BY start_station_name
ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 5;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Open **Execution details**. The plan reads `mv_trips_by_station` instead of the full table, and bytes processed is much lower.

5. **[CLI] Check refresh status and trigger a manual refresh.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq show --format=prettyjson lab02.mv_trips_by_station | grep -E "lastRefreshTime|enableRefresh|refreshIntervalMs"
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'CALL BQ.REFRESH_MATERIALIZED_VIEW("lab02.mv_trips_by_station")'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **[Console] Compare in Explorer.** The logical view has a view icon and no storage. The materialized view shows **Storage info** and **Last refresh time**.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Logical view | No storage, always runs the full query |
| Materialized view | Stored, refreshed automatically |
| Query rewrite | Base-table query served by the materialized view |
| Manual refresh | `BQ.REFRESH_MATERIALIZED_VIEW` |
